name: Hayward Area Historical Society Volunteers
what_you_do: You help at the history museum and old houses. You can lead tours, greet guests, help kids with crafts or work the front desk.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be 16 or older. The program page has no separate teen track.
pay_detail: Volunteer. The program page does not list pay or service hours.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadline.
how_to_apply: Email the education office or call the museum and ask to volunteer. You log your hours online after you start.
notes: The program page does not describe orientation, training or required hours. Phone: 510-581-0223, extension 161. The internships on the same page are for college and graduate students, not high school.
